title: The God Who Owns Everything Chose You

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: To the Lord your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, the earth and everything in it. Yet the Lord set his affection on your ancestors and loved them, and he chose you, their descendants, above all the nations—as it is today. - Deut 10:14-15 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses lifts our eyes to the greatness of God: everything belongs to Him — "the heavens, even the highest heavens, the earth and everything in it." The entire universe is His. And then comes the astonishing "yet." This infinite God, who owns all things and needs nothing, "set his affection" on His people and chose them in love. The God who has everything chose to love a small, undeserving nation. The bigness of God makes the tenderness of His love all the more amazing.

Let this sink in. The God who flung the stars into space, who owns every galaxy and holds all things together, is the same God who bends down in love toward His people. His greatness does not make Him distant or indifferent; it makes His love all the more staggering. He did not need Israel — He needs nothing — yet He loved them freely, purely out of grace.

This is the wonder of the gospel too. The God of infinite majesty set His affection on you. He did not have to; He gains nothing from it that He lacked. Yet "in love he predestined us for adoption to sonship through Jesus Christ" (Eph 1:4-5). The Creator of all things calls you His beloved child. When you feel small, forgotten, or insignificant, remember: the God who owns everything chose to love you. That love is not earned and cannot be lost, because it flows from His heart, not your worth. Rest today in the affection of the God who has everything and still wanted you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Does the greatness of God make His love feel more amazing to me, or more distant?
- How does it move me that the God who owns everything chose to love me?
- Where do I need to rest today in God's freely given affection?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Almighty God, You own the heavens and the earth and need nothing, yet You set Your affection on me and call me Your own. I am amazed by such love. Help me rest in Your freely given affection, secure as Your beloved child in Christ. Amen.
